evidence.provider: Government of Viet Nam — Government News
evidence.title: Viet Nam, Myanmar agree to transform defense-security cooperation into key pillar of bilateral ties
evidence.notes: Primary Government of Viet Nam report published at 16:16 GMT+7 on 5 September 2026 (09:16 UTC). It states that the leaders agreed to make defence and security cooperation a key pillar of bilateral relations and identifies specific cooperation areas. The article publication clock time is not treated as the summit event time.

evidence.title: General Assembly adopts text to ‘Correct the Map’, among other resolutions — GA/12779
evidence.notes: Primary UN meeting-coverage evidence for adoption on 4 September 2026 at the General Assembly's 114th plenary meeting. The draft A/80/L.104 was adopted as A/RES/80/307 by recorded vote 164 in favour, 1 against and 6 abstentions. No publication clock time is promoted from this civil-date source surface.

evidence.title: Communiqué of the Chairperson of the African Union Commission on the Adoption of the ‘Correct The Map’ Resolution
evidence.notes: Primary African Union evidence confirming the Africa-led institutional initiative, Togo's role on behalf of the African Group, and the AU Commission's stated intention to support implementation. The evidence is contextual confirmation, not authority for the UN vote record itself.

evidence.title: GPH-MILF forge commitment to promote peaceful electoral process during the BARMM polls
evidence.notes: Official Philippine government information-agency reporting that GPH representatives, MILF ground commanders and other stakeholders signed ceasefire-related coordination guidelines and a pledge for a peaceful electoral process ahead of the 14 September 2026 BARMM parliamentary election. The page does not supply a source-native exact date/time for the signing beyond describing it as recent, so CG does not manufacture event_time.

evidence.provider: Government of the Cook Islands — Office of the Prime Minister
evidence.title: Prime Minister concludes 55th Pacific Islands Forum Leaders Meeting
evidence.notes: Primary official member-government post-event evidence. It states that the Leaders’ Retreat resolved the framework guiding Pacific engagement with partners and describes the approach as transparent, accountable and Pacific-led in support of the 2050 Strategy. CL uses this page as reviewed factual evidence only; it does not grant the source unattended-monitoring authority or alter Canonical provenance.

evidence.title: Governo Federal adota novas medidas para combustíveis após novos aumentos do petróleo
evidence.notes: Primary official Finance Ministry announcement. The page displays 09/09/2026 18h47 but the reviewed page does not itself establish an IANA timezone for that clock time, so CN preserves publication precision only as a civil date. The article says the Federal Government adopted/signed a temporary gasoline/ethanol tax measure and diesel-subsidy measure on 9 September. Fresh post-CM Planalto index review had not yet surfaced the new substantive legal-instrument pair, so this evidence row does not assert Diário Oficial publication, legal instrument numbers or entry into force.

evidence.title: List of products from the United States subject to counter-tariffs effective September 8, 2026
evidence.notes: Primary official Department of Finance backgrounder. Canada's archived-news index dates the page to 25 August 2026; the product list states it was updated as of 26 August. The source states that Canada will apply 15%, 25% and 50% counter-tariffs to listed U.S.-origin goods effective 8 September 2026, covering $27.6 billion in imports from the United States, and displays an effective clock time of 12:01 a.m. without establishing an IANA timezone. CO therefore preserves the event at civil-date precision rather than manufacturing UTC.

evidence.title: Customs Notice 26-23: United States Surtax Order (2026)
evidence.notes: Primary official CBSA administrative notice dated Ottawa, 7 September 2026. It states that, effective 8 September 2026, certain U.S.-origin goods imported into Canada are subject under the United States Surtax Order (2026) to surtaxes of 15%, 25% or 50% of value for duty, as applicable. The notice establishes operative border application for the bounded CO claim; it does not grant unattended-monitoring or Canonical provenance authority.
